question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Left out in the cold
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"Left out in the cold"** means to be ignored or excluded from something. (अनदेखा करना या किसी चीज से बाहर रखना)

 
 
• **Example:** When the project was handed out, she felt left out in the cold as she wasn't given any significant tasks.
 
 
 
• **"Ignored" **means to deliberately pay no attention to someone or something. (अनदेखा करना)
 
 
• **Example:** He ignored all the warnings and went ahead with his plan.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To go underground **(भूमिगत हो जाना): To go into hiding or to become secretive.

 
 
• **Example:** After the scandal, he decided to go underground to avoid the media.
 
 
 
• **To be in hiding **(छिपा हुआ होना): To stay in a place where you cannot be found.
 
 
• **Example:** The fugitive was in hiding for several months before he was captured.
 
 
 
• **To be extremely negative **(अत्यंत नकारात्मक होना): To have a very pessimistic outlook or attitude.
 
 
• **Example:** His comments about the project were extremely negative and unhelpful.
 
 

36:Tc94,
The correct answer is **Option 4**.
